objective: Define the smallest execution boundary after accepted direct command-path sidecar stage-plan materialization metadata, while keeping this gate definition-only and avoiding direct command execution, sidecar stage execution, RTL simulation, compare execution, measured timing, speedup, arbitrary filelist support, automatic GPU allocation, runtime/ABI change, or native Verilator option support claims.

definition_decision.weakest_point: The accepted materialization fixture exposes a reviewed sidecar stage plan, but it is still metadata reached from a direct parser fixture. A later run gate therefore must validate the ready materialization fixture, preserve or regenerate the reviewed sidecar stage order, and execute only scoped sidecar build/run/compare stages after a separate execution-boundary review accepts them. The metadata must not be treated as native Verilator option support, direct command execution, measured timing, arbitrary filelist support, automatic allocation, runtime/ABI change, or raw full-state equality evidence.
